comparison_rule: Compare Step 16B clipped geometry with full modelling cells after clipping to KMC boundary.
limitations: Zoning is screenshot-derived, provisional, low confidence and legally unverified.
The original Step 16B boundary-clipped grid is retained.
Classified, unclassified and unmapped are exclusive categories.
Conservation, water, ambiguous and highland review layers may overlap other categories.
Review flags are not legal exclusions, construction approvals or suitability scores.
Very small KMC boundary fragments are retained. Percentages use actual clipped-cell area.
No AHP weights, final suitability index or official zoning rules applied.
